svg.title: Every individual expanded public slowdown over 20%
svg.desc: Public development only; final independent benchmark failed; no final winner. CPython, C, Rust, and Zig ran the same 8192 calibration-only public cases, 13 paired trials, and 2000 bootstrap draws. Every one of the 5,940 observed substantial slowdowns; no case is hidden. Public manifest SHA-256 65e024a1a79d13b03e4e5ad0f3d4ae010dbb6e4f09b52a8542837a2ea4c6198a; public summary SHA-256 539fe6ba0ac492ffab121845da21033676ad7e7154ce9107f7f1778f55ceed4c. Final speed, final memory, and final candidate ranking: NOT MEASURED. Final winner: NONE.

Every measured substantial loss is named individually; bars use a zero-preserving logarithmic visual scale. Final regressions: NOT MEASURED.
